ground.units: rates multiplied by 0.002 s each action; failure penalty once
ground.pose_formula: weight / (1 + group mean squared error / scale squared)
ground.task_scope: stand: full initial hinge pose; walk: resting wings and body, legs free

hover.height_target: requested altitude, independent of reset altitude
hover.reward_timing: rate * actual control_dt; failure penalty once before reset

reward_recipe.selection: task 0/1: ground reward; task 2: hover reward, never their sum
reward_recipe.failure_penalty: one selected -1 penalty on failure; world resets immediately

physical_contract.wing_body_coupling: custom flight law reads measured wing motion
physical_contract.scope: body, joints, contacts, actuation, physics options and force parameters; observer sensors/cameras excluded

wing_supervision.target: bounded corrective torque from pre-action measured wing q/qvel
wing_supervision.loss: mean squared normalized action error over six wing channels only

motor_retention.scope: all 78 mean motor outputs, ground worlds only

physical_timescales.interpretation: Trace decay is not a hard horizon; the critic bootstraps later returns

flight_force_model.name: Flight dynamics driven by measured wing motion
flight_force_model.inputs: six actual wing angles and speeds; measured body orientation/velocity
flight_force_model.attitude_assistance: activity-dependent angular damping and restoring torque
flight_force_model.translation: bounded wing-motion lift/thrust and drag; no target-position servo

failure_trace.scope: last up to 0.256 s; post-action physical states
